description: This file is a Cypress configuration script written in JavaScript for setting up end-to-end testing with Cypress. It defines configuration options and custom tasks related to database state management via Axios HTTP requests, tailored for testing the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: asyncWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a promise to provide error handling, returning a tuple of [result, null] or [null, error]

methods.name: createSavePoint
methods.description: Creates a database savepoint by sending a POST request to the testing API endpoint

methods.name: restoreToSavePoint
methods.description: Restores the database to a specified savepoint via API call

methods.name: deleteSavePoints
methods.description: Deletes specified savepoints from the system using an API request

methods.name: resetDatabase
methods.description: Resets the database to a fresh install state using an API call

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Truncates specified database tables using an API request
